note: Structured (non-prose) AMO listing metadata. Prose lives in the per-locale description.*.md files. The summary is NOT here: it is reused from manifest-locales.json (the Firefox short description) so the manifest and the AMO summary stay in sync. The license is NOT here either: build-amo-metadata.mjs emits the complete AGPL-3.0-or-later grant and section 7 terms as custom_license from LICENSE.md. Do not add version.license — AMO rejects license and custom_license together, and its predefined AGPL slug is 3.0-only. Every configured manifest locale must be mapped exactly once or named in unsupportedManifestLocales when production AMO does not accept it. Run `pnpm task generate:amo-metadata` after editing; `pnpm task check:amo-metadata` guards drift.
